network.description: Custom balanced 3-phase, 33/11/0.415 kV teaching feeder. Not an IEEE benchmark or utility model.

manifest.execution: Sequential fresh worker per paired seed. Method times exclude process startup; total campaign time includes it. Native contexts are released at process exit.
manifest.methodology: Paired seeds, identical admissible 0.05 grid, same complete-incident budget, no repeated point within a method. First four points match. Alternate method order by seed. One unscored warm-up. No reduction costs included.
manifest.censoring: A run without a failure is assigned budget+1 (25) only for the explicitly capped first-failure metric and paired comparison. It is not an observed discovery time.
manifest.limits: Six predetermined seeds per condition. One custom feeder and one fault location. Correlated failing scenarios are not distinct defects. Searcher sees simulator truth; controllers do not. No search result establishes field safety, calibrated risk, or research novelty.
